exceptions.rationale: Locked only through dioxus-desktop (gtk 0.18 via muda), which the workspace does not enable: glib is not in the build graph of any workspace target. The fix is in glib 0.20, which gtk 0.18 cannot use.

Locked only as a build-time dependency of phf_generator 0.8 under dioxus-desktop (wry, kuchikiki, selectors), which the workspace does not enable: rand 0.7.3 is not in the build graph. The 0.7 line has no fixed release.
No fixed release exists. Locked only through the optional MySQL backend of sqlx 0.8.6; the workspace enables only the sqlite feature, so rsa is not compiled into any workspace target.
